name: Ray Summit
full: Ray Summit

note: Not announced. estimated from 2025–2026 pattern (2025 CFP closed June 30, 2026 event August 24–26 in San Francisco).

name: RLC
full: Reinforcement Learning Conference
origin: First held at UMass Amherst in 2024, organized by Amy Zhang, Eugene Vinitsky and Glenn Berseth with UMass faculty as a dedicated conference for reinforcement learning research.
note: Two locations announced (Brown University in early August 2027, Odense joint with EWRL in late August 2027), exact dates TBA. Deadline estimated from 2025–2026 pattern (2026 paper deadline March 5).

name: SACMAT
full: ACM Symposium on Access Control Models and Technologies
origin: An ACM SIGSAC symposium on access-control models and technologies that grew out of the ACM Workshop on Role-Based Access Control, first held in 1995, and took the SACMAT name in 2001.
note: Event dates, venue and both cycle deadlines confirmed on the official call for papers. Cycle 1 notification Dec 21, 2026.

name: SACMAT

name: SAIV

origin: International Symposium on AI Verification co-located with CAV since 2024, continuing the FoMLAS and WOLVERINE series and hosting VNN-COMP, with proceedings in Springer LNCS.

name: TMLR
full: Transactions on Machine Learning Research
origin: TMLR launched in 2022 as an OpenReview based journal that reviews for correctness rather than perceived impact.
note: Journal with rolling submissions, no deadlines.

name: UAI

origin: UAI was first held in 1985 and is the main venue for probabilistic reasoning and decision making under uncertainty.
note: estimated from 2025–2026 pattern (UAI 2026 deadline Feb 25). Not announced. Conference expected Jul-Aug 2027 (UAI 2026 was Aug 17-21 in Amsterdam).

name: VeriCodeGen
full: VeriCodeGen: AI for Verifiable Coding (NeurIPS Workshop)
origin: New NeurIPS 2026 workshop on AI for verifiable coding, where agents work with proof assistants, model checkers and solvers to produce machine-checkable code, organized by Wuyang Chen, Soonho Kong, Hakjoo Oh and others.
note: First edition, NeurIPS 2026 Atlanta site. Deadlines passed. Also relevant at NeurIPS 2026 Sydney site: Verify-Agents and Meta-Agents workshops.

name: VerifAI
full: Workshop on AI Verification in the Wild (ICLR)
origin: ICLR workshop first held in 2025 on combining generative AI with formal verification, organized by Celine Lee, Wenting Zhao, Ameesh Shah, Theo X. Olausson, Tao Yu and Sean Welleck.
note: Estimated from 2025–2026 pattern (VerifAI-1 at ICLR 2025, VerifAI-2 at ICLR 2026), assuming a third edition is accepted. ICLR 2027 workshop days are Apr 29–30, location listed as TBA officially (third-party listings say San Francisco).
